units.source_text: 内藏助抬起头来不再看《三国志》，深深凝望远方。

en.t: Kuranosuke raised his head from The Romance of the Three Kingdoms and gazed deeply into the distance.

units.source_text: 他一言不发的把手放到火盆上方取暖。

en.t: Without saying a word, he held his hands over the brazier to warm them.

units.source_text: 火盆上面罩着铁丝网，下面是烧的火红的木炭，

en.t: A wire mesh covered the top of the brazier, and beneath it the charcoal was glowing red,

units.source_text: 火红的炭火照亮了燃尽的炭灰。

en.t: the fiery red coals lit up the ash of the burned-out charcoal.

units.source_text: 内藏助被温暖的热气笼罩，内心非常愉快。

en.t: Kuranosuke was enveloped in the warm heat, and in his heart he felt deeply content.

units.source_text: 去年腊月十五日他们故主报了仇，当时撤到泉兵寺的时候，他曾吟道：“快哉雪恨身可舍，尘世之月无云遮。”

en.t: On the fifteenth day of the twelfth lunar month last year, they avenged their late lord, and when they withdrew to Quanbing Temple, he had chanted, How splendid to wash away our hatred, though this body may be cast aside; the moon over the dusty world is hidden by no cloud.

units.source_text: 今天他再次体会到当时怡然的心情。

en.t: Today he once again felt the serene pleasure he had known then.
